probe.text_sample: capricorn 01 Zagato | Limited Edition Hypercar – capricorn 01 Zagato | Limited Edition Hypercar capricorn GROUP Press release Get in touch Capricorn Zagato The essential machine Get in touch Every gram refined into time The capricorn 01 Zagato engineering without compromise Limited to just 19 coupes, the capricorn 01 Zagato is not a hypercar to be collected and hidden. Road-legal by design, it is meant to be driven, felt, and remembered. The perfect union The capricorn 01 Zagato unites two disciplines rarely mastered together: engineering purity and emotional design. Every Gram Counts Carbon fibre and titanium, balanced for agility and feel 900+ HP V8 Engine 1200 KG Dry weight 5 SPEED Manual Transmission German art of engineering Since 1933, capricorn GROUP has shaped the unseen–precision components, carbon systems, and engineering solutions that power the most successful machines in motorsport. From Formula 1 to Le Mans, the company has been a trusted partner to teams who demand total performance and total reliability. In capricorn’s world, engineering is not a function. It is a craft - honest, tested and refined. capricorn GROUP CEO Robertino Wild Italian engineering of art Zagat
